messages:
Arjun: kicking off a quick canary for nv2p1-int4 quant bring-up, want to confirm automatic fallback thresholds before we push to 20% :eyes:
Jenna: nice — what slice are we seeding? longdoc + shortanswers mix?
Arjun: start 5% longdoc-heavy, 5% shortanswers, then step to 20% if metrics stable for 30m
Kai: quick flag proposal: rollback if relative MRR drops > 2.0% OR hallucination rate delta > 0.8 percentage points (measured on our eval slices)
Maria: +1 but add a latency tail check: p99 token latency increase > 30% should also trigger fallback
Jenna: agree. also add a soft-alert at 1.0% MRR drop so SRE/product can triage before auto rollback
Arjun: sounds good. draft thresholds below — please nitpick:
```
{
  "mrr_relative_drop_pct": 2.0,
  "hallucination_delta_pp": 0.8,
  "p99_latency_increase_pct": 30,
  "soft_alert_mrr_pct": 1.0,
  "monitor_window_mins": 30,
  "min_samples": 5000
}
```
Kai: \'min_samples\' should be 2000 for our seeded slices at 5% traffic, otherwise autopromote never evaluates
Maria: hmm ok but that weakens statistic. maybe keep 5000 but allow fallback to evaluate on aggregated 30m sliding window across slices
Arjun: updated: keep 5000 but aggregate across seeds; also enabling canary-kv-warmup to avoid cold-start regressions
Jenna: deploy-bot started the canary at 1723467920 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: nv2p1-int4 @ 5% (longdoc + shortanswers), monitoring: mrr, hallucination, p99_latency
Jenna: first 15m smoke looks fine — MRR delta +0.1%, hallucination -0.02pp, p99 +4%
Kai: good sign. tagging eval-team to run manual checks on high-risk prompts: @Maria @Arjun
Maria: ran a 2000-sample rerun on the longdoc holdout: small formatting hallucinations up from 0.6% -> 1.1% (0.5pp). not huge but trending
Arjun: that's concerning given our 0.8pp threshold — but that's on a small slice. continuing to monitor until min_samples hit
Jenna: reaching 5k aggregated samples in ~8m
Maria: aggregated at 5k now: MRR -1.7%, hallucination +0.9pp, p99 +6%
Kai: that crosses hallucination threshold and MRR below 2% as well -> auto-fallback should trigger now by our rules
deploy-bot: Auto-fallback executed at 1723468040. Canary reverted to baseline model. Reason: hallucination_delta_pp=+0.9, mrr_relative_drop_pct=1.7
Arjun: thanks — can we capture the exact sample slices that caused the bump? file the canary dump to s3://redwood-canary-dumps/1723467890-dump.json
Jenna: filing a follow-up playbook: quick root-cause: small-formatting prompts causing hallucination bump. next steps: add prompt sanitization, re-run quant with kv-warmup tweak and a smaller learning-free calibration pass
Maria: also propose lowering canary step to 3% next attempt and extend monitor_window to 45m
Kai: +1 to both. I'll open a rollup issue with telemetry links and A/B artifact (diff of token-level logits)
Arjun: good work. closing thread for now, will re-run when we have calibration artifacts. :white_check_mark:
